wholePhysicalScope: Sixteen native footprint controls and the municipal heritage section establish an octagonal central hall and four attached, double-eaved ranges. The south view and same-day façade detail control the curved blue tile, gilded crown, crimson columns and dark red woodwork.
lodDetails: All four levels preserve the mapped octagonal crown, gilt finial, four wings, south portico and granite apron. Close levels add painted brackets, swept eaves and lattice bars.
limitations: May 2013 main hall. Detached gate, garden structures, monument and statue are outside the exterior asset.
Roof tier sections, mouldings, inscriptions, and individual glazing bays are approximate where the accepted images provide incomplete coverage.

The original terrain samples are preserved. The renderer clips the source surface inside the estimated granite apron to clear the hall and entrance steps. Retaining edges and local thresholds are approximate.
